subject: sty
title: (R)STY.------PROJ.DY.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-35. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'The retrograde affinity tendency functions as a factor to keep the people of its culture aware of the dynamic route of its path.' The crossing diagrams how reality-of-stylization structurally meets projection-dynamics at the retrograde-affinity-tendency scale: (R)STY crossed with PROJ-DY. STY sits at left with the subject-arrow; PROJ-DY at center as partner-axis. AF-POST (affinity postulation), RIT-DT (ritual dictates), POL-SIGN (political signal), RT-INT-TR (reality-internal transformation), SPT-DE (spectacle dictates) upper chain. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication), MD-DY (medium dynamics), CULT-AF-B (cultural-affinity base) center-right. LK-IMP (linkage implication), PER-DY (perceived dynamics), PRI-INFO (principle information), OBS (observation) lower chain.
